description: Local MCP server registry. The agent reads this file at startup to discover which servers it may connect to. Each entry describes how to spawn the server (stdio transport) and a human-readable category used by the 'categorized' tool-selection strategy.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Read, write, list and search files under the project's ./data directory.

servers.name: calculator
servers.description: Arithmetic, algebra and unit-conversion helpers. Pure functions, no side effects.

servers.name: sqlite
servers.description: Run SQL queries (SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE) against a local SQLite database stored under ./data/agent.db.

servers.name: search
servers.description: Web-search style helpers. Uses a small in-memory knowledge base so the project runs offline; swap the implementation for a real search API in production.

servers.name: custom
servers.description: Miscellaneous utility tools: current time, currency conversion (static rates), string transforms, UUID generation and a notes key-value store.
